limits: Three matched families, not twelve independent generalization samples.
Fixed call order/time and desktop/WDDM activity confound latency and condition attribution.
Exact visible expected-value presence is not complete OCR character accuracy or semantic association.
Repeated values remain ambiguous; table local row identity is separately recorded.
Ideal native witnesses are reference-only support checks, not actual model output.
Typed quantities retain numeric-only historical semantics after supported-unit validation.
Mapped absence violations and extra candidates are not comprehensive invention detection.
Single composite degradation severity and finite clean-layout set; no retries or source tuning.
